{{incomprehensible|date=October 2017}}
In mathematics, the '''actuarial polynomials''' ''a''{{su|b=''n''|p=(β)}}(''x'') are polynomials given by the [[generating function]]

:<math>\displaystyle \sum_n \frac{a_n^{(\beta)}(x)}{n!}t^n = \exp(\beta t +x(1-e^t))</math>

{{sfnp|Toscano|1950}}{{sfnp|Roman|1984|loc=4.3.4}}{{sfnp|Boas|Buck|1958}}
